title: AI governance in practice

parts.head: CODIFY · CenterStart
parts.body: Experts turn their judgment into rules: discount limits, standard clauses.

text: New rules and rule changes both cross here. Each keeps who set it, who approved it and why.

parts.head: COMPANY A'S SPACE · CenterSquare
parts.body: The shared context: the experts' rules, pricing, past contracts, the customer's history. Team spaces inside it add their own.

text: The salesperson's CenterEye may read Company A's space for Sales.

parts.head: THE ASK · CONTEXT · CenterEye
parts.body: The salesperson asks their agent for a contract. Their CenterEye adds Company A's shared context and their own accounts and history.

text: The gate reads and checks the ask's intent:

parts.head: THE DRAFT
parts.body: The salesperson's agent drafts the contract from both kinds of context.

parts.head: CONDUIT · CenterLoop
parts.body: The agent asks Salesforce for the customer's details through a standard AI connector (MCP).

text: Sales may read its own accounts in Salesforce.

parts.head: SCOPE · CenterSquare
parts.body: Sales limits flow down to the salesperson: 25% for the team and 10% for them. The draft asks for 20%.

text: 20% is over the salesperson's 10% and under the team's 25%. The sales manager is pulled in the loop and approves.
parts.recorded: the manager approved 20%. Why: a multi-year deal.

parts.head: SALES MANAGER · IN THE LOOP
parts.body: Sees the request and its reason. Approves 20%.

text: Sales may hand Legal a draft for review. No contract leaves Company A without Legal's review.

parts.head: CONDUIT · CenterLoop
parts.body: Legal's agent reviews the draft and finds a non-standard clause. After the lawyer's approval it sends the draft out.

text: A non-standard liability clause. The lawyer is pulled in the loop and approves.

parts.head: LAWYER · IN THE LOOP
parts.body: Sees the clause and its reason. Approves it.

text: Legal's agent also attached the customer's full Salesforce record. It can't leave Company A. Only the attachment stops here.
parts.recorded: attachment blocked; the contract went on.

text: The draft may go to the customer's Legal team for review.
parts.recorded: draft sent to the customer without the attachment.

parts.head: CONDUIT · CenterLoop
parts.body: The customer's Legal team reviews under its own rules and sends back changes.

text: The customer's changes are inside Company A's rules.
Over the quarter the same 20% exception was approved three times. The Sales expert gets one question: should multi-year deals get 20% without approval?
parts.recorded: the question sent to the Sales expert.

parts.head: BACK TO CODIFY · CenterStart
parts.body: The Sales expert updates the rule: multi-year deals up to 20%. The head of Sales approves the change.

pieces.name: CODIFY · CenterStart
pieces.line: Turn an expert's judgment into rules an AI can follow.

pieces.name: CONTEXT · CenterEye
pieces.line: Every AI works from the same intent.

pieces.name: SCOPE · CenterSquare
pieces.line: Company rules flow down to the right projects, teams and people.

pieces.name: CONDUIT · CenterLoop
pieces.line: Agents and people pass work and messages across systems and back, with humans in the loop or on the loop.

pieces.name: GOVERN · CenterGovern
pieces.line: Every step enforced, traced, auditable and accountable, with the intent behind each decision kept as it changes.

gate_lines: Every line between lanes, teams or companies marks a handoff.
Each crossing has a gold gate. It reads the intent: who, what, why, on whose authority, until when.
It checks the rules in scope and records the decision with its reason.

outcomes.line: a person is pulled in the loop to decide.
a repeated exception goes back to the experts.

record.head: THE RECORD · CenterGovern
record.body: Every gate on the way is kept: what was asked, the rules, the outcome, who decided and why. Later changes of intent are kept too.

loop.head: ON THE LOOP
loop.body: Everyone else watches the record and gets alerts. Any of them can step in.
